rapport_notes: Friendly, professional; proactively offered a cheaper day when the customer signaled budget sensitivity.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "what are you most worried about for this upcoming move or do you have any specific question..."
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer named three things (care, cost, time) — rep responded only to cost/stress generally and moved straight into the pricing pitch without circling back to "care" specifically.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "you're not done by the estimate, you only pay for the actual time that you use" (pay-less concept); "staging the boxes... disassemble the bed in advance... save time and money" (self-prep hit); "does that make sense so far?" asked with genuine response.

top_strength: Proactively offered a cheaper Sunday slot when the customer signaled budget sensitivity — real value-based selling, not just quoting the number.
coaching_note: Customer named "care" as a top worry and it was never circled back to or answered directly — a five-point damage-coverage item left on the table for a customer who volunteered exactly that concern.
